scope: Class 1 proposals only; never automatically accepted training labels
policy: Derive all prompts from the raw proposal, never from reference masks or image-specific annotations. Two point-prompt passes must agree on each edit. Preserve deep interiors and substantial enclosed holes. Large edits or failures retain the baseline and are deferred. Geometry/quality checks are not semantic proof; true driveway pavement, road, leaves, cracks and shadows still require review. Non-sidewalk pixels remain unassigned (255).
